name: zc_make_fire_material

tests.name: the project has its own fire material
it is additive, unlit and two-sided
it exposes the "Color" parameter the figures already write

detail.note: the embodiment, the colourway, the heartbeat and the wardrobe's glow scale all dress flames through SetVectorParameterValue('Color'). A different name would leave every flame black.

tests.name: its shape, flicker and falloff are all tunable without a rebuild
